title: Viva Hot Babes did not cancel VMX Babes' guesting, says Maui Taylor
summary: Maui Taylor on Monday clarified that it was their management, not the Viva Hot Babes, that decided to "cancel" the VMX Babes' guest appearance at their "Bulaklak" reunion concert.
